# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.22 — Native Island full integration

<!-- update-summary: Preview.22 integrates priority-routed native activities into the existing Dynamic Island while preserving Smart Drag/OLE, startup, updater, and system-volume ownership boundaries. -->

Preview.22 is the Native Island integration Preview defined by the project plan. It raises the x64 Windows minimum to build 20348 and adds the runtime contracts, settings migration, localization, tests, and Windows API adapters needed for media, lyrics, spectrum, notifications, volume observation, and native widgets.

## Shipped changes

- Adds `IslandActivityRouter`, with deterministic priority ordering, source replacement, expiry, and Drop/Manual/Notification/Volume/Media/Widget activity lifetimes. Existing Compact, Expanded, and Smart Drag surfaces remain the only overlay surface.
- Adds Windows System Media Transport Controls integration with metadata, artwork size bounds, playback state, timeline/progress, play/pause, previous, next, and seek contracts. Media activity is disabled safely when SMTC is unavailable.
- Adds online/local timed-lyrics plumbing with LRC parsing, multiple timestamps, delay bounds, normalized queries, LRCLIB/AMLL/NetEase/QQ Music/Kugou endpoints, and bounded local-LRC lookup. Lyrics lookup is cancellation-safe and never blocks startup.
- Adds a bounded spectrum service that samples only while media is playing. Process-loopback is the preferred capture mode in the contract; the endpoint meter is used as the explicit capability-gated fallback when a single media process cannot be resolved.
- Adds opt-in Windows notification listener activity and default-render-endpoint volume observation. DropSpace does not replace the Windows volume flyout, install a keyboard hook, or take ownership of system volume UI.
- Adds Clock, Calendar, Resource Usage, and Settings widget models with a normalized 6×3 layout contract and compact activity projection.
- Adds schema 12 settings for the Native Island feature switches and bounded appearance/lyrics/widget settings, with synchronized en-US/zh-CN labels and recoverable settings transactions.
- Updates the package, identity, installer, updater, README, compatibility report, and official website source to the Windows build 20348 boundary.

## Verification

- Core tests cover activity priority/source replacement, timed-lyrics parsing, 6×3 widget normalization, and the inclusive Windows build 20348 boundary.
- Localization XML/key parity, manifest XML parsing, forbidden-boundary scan, and `git diff --check` pass in the source workspace.
- The Windows CI and Release workflows remain the authoritative gates for WinUI compilation, WinRT API projections, package/installer generation, portable smoke, release metadata, and public artifact verification.

## Conditional target verification

Physical Windows media-player coverage, notification permission states, audio endpoint changes, process-loopback capability, high-DPI/multi-monitor behavior, accessibility, and long-run resource stability remain conditional until recorded on the target Windows matrix. Hosted CI does not substitute for those runtime rows.

The release publishes the five validated Preview assets: `DropSpace-x64.msix`, `DropSpace.exe`, `DropSpaceSetup.exe`, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and `update-manifest.json`.
